Detailed patient interviews were conducted by telephone, in person, or via the Internet with 86 (68%) of 127 patients.

methods_quotes.q: Patients were counted as THC users if they reported use of at least one THC-containing e-cigarette product in the past 3 months.
The denominator used here is all patients, not just those who reported using THC- or nicotine-containing products.
Patients could report using more than one type of device or product, thus the percentage totals sum to >100%.
